content.text:
I fixed the layout change. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, and I didn't approve or change any baselines.

The cause was two edits in `site/css/styles.css`, which together shifted the layout:

1. **Paragraph spacing:** `p { margin-bottom }` was `1.5rem`, but Bootstrap's default is `1rem`. This made the hero section 8px too tall and pushed the "Call to action" button and everything below it down. I set it back to `1rem` (line 168).
2. **Feature icons:** `.feature` was `display: inline-block`. The icons sat on the text baseline instead of being centred, and each card row came out 4px short. I set it back to `inline-flex` (line 11553), which is what the original Heroic Features template uses and what the `align-items` and `justify-content` rules next to it need.

Each fix on its own made the diff look worse, because the two regressions pushed the page height in opposite directions and partly hid each other. Only the two together matched the baseline.

The change is in the working tree and not committed.

STATUS: DONE
